speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
text: asked the Minister for Health in view of China easing its travel restrictions and the number of visitors to Singapore is expected to increase (a) what measures are in place to prevent a new wave of COVID-19 infection in Singapore should a new virus variant emerge; and (b) whether an additional dose of COVID-19 booster vaccination will be necessary, especially for the elderly.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: I invite these Members to also seek clarifications if they wish to, at the end of my Ministerial Statement.
